rulings.item: Coordinator note #7265: DT_NEEDED libc.so.6 by soname with DT_RPATH/DT_RUNPATH <dir>: the reference maps <dir>/libc.so.6; libniji opens only /lib/libc.so.6 (<prefix>/<libdir>, the pin of R14-3 (a) / threat-model rule 9) and fails. Not the $ORIGIN search defect; the pin has no differences-from-glibc.md row
rulings.recommendation: keep the pin, add the differences row; decide separately whether a development build with products outside the prefix gets a fallback

informational: Ruling #7190 asked for 'the hook or seam the start uses for #7094': the start has none (its secure tests use set-group-ID copies). The new test forces AT_SECURE in the test program's own auxiliary vector (no product seam) and gets a trusted $ORIGIN by binding the corpus over a default directory in unshare -r -m; it also runs a set-group-ID copy (the kernel's flag)
$PLATFORM is haswell on an x86-64-v3 CPU (D-27.16); on the Zen 1 host the reference gives x86_64: a loader story should probe both
start-time objects without DT_SONAME are still left out of a handle's local scope (adopt_deps matches soname or path only)

impact.what: dlopen of a bare name through the program's DT_RUNPATH $ORIGIN (Yohane y10 probe, dl-nopie and dl-pie) in a trixie root with this head's packages
secure_dlopen_origin_only_trusted (forced flag untrusted / trusted, set-group-ID) and plant no-secure-rule
DL-RUNPATH lands (CI conflict in dlopen.rs resolved onto the arena API)

improvement: A brief that names a release probe (y10) could name its script and package recipe; finding them took several calls. A 'force AT_SECURE in the test's own auxv' helper beside the set-group-ID helpers would let every secure-mode test run without a supplementary group
